title: Architectural Design
tagline: From the first sketch to the last working drawing
summary: Concept design, Vastu-aligned planning, elevations and complete working drawings — coordinated with structure and services from the very first cycle.
description: Most delays on site begin as a drawing problem. We design the architecture, structure and services together from concept stage, so the drawings that reach site are already coordinated. Vastu is resolved during planning rather than patched afterwards, which is the only way it can be done without compromising the plan.

features.title: Concept & massing
features.description: Site study, setbacks, sun path and the first three-dimensional idea of the building.

features.title: Vastu-aligned planning
features.description: Direction-wise placement of entrance, kitchen, master bedroom and services resolved in the plan itself.

features.title: Elevation & material design
features.description: Facade composition, material palette and detailing developed to a buildable level.

features.title: Working drawings
features.description: Dimensioned plans, sections, details and schedules — the full set your site actually needs.

features.title: 3D visualisation
features.description: Photorealistic views so you approve what you will actually get.

features.title: Approval drawings
features.description: Submission-ready drawings for municipal and JDA approvals.

deliverables: Approved floor plans, elevations and sections

process.title: Brief & site study
process.description: We measure the plot, study sun and wind, and record exactly how you want to live.

process.title: Concept & Vastu

process.title: Design development
process.description: The chosen option develops into elevations, sections and 3D views.

process.title: Coordination
process.description: Structure and MEPF are overlaid and every clash is resolved on paper.

process.title: Working drawings
process.description: The full construction set is issued, along with approval submissions.

title: MEPF Consultancy
tagline: The systems that decide whether a building actually works
summary: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire-fighting design and supervision — the invisible infrastructure that makes buildings livable, functional and safe.
description: MEPF is the heartbeat of every building. Get it wrong and you live with the consequences for thirty years: chased walls, undersized cables, blocked drains, a fire system that would not pass inspection. We design all four disciplines in-house and supervise them on site, which means one team owns the outcome instead of four contractors pointing at each other.

features.title: Mechanical (HVAC)
features.description: Heat load calculation, ducting, VRF/split system design, ventilation and building automation.

features.title: Electrical
features.description: Load estimation, panel and cable sizing, earthing, lighting design, backup power and automation readiness.

features.title: Plumbing
features.description: Supply and drainage layouts, pump sizing, water heating, rainwater harvesting and waterproofing coordination.

features.title: Fire Fighting
features.description: Detection and alarm design, sprinkler and hydrant networks, extinguisher placement and evacuation planning.

features.title: Services coordination
features.description: All four disciplines overlaid on the structure so nothing is cut or chased after casting.

features.title: Site supervision
features.description: Stage-wise inspection of first fix, second fix, testing and commissioning.

deliverables: Heat load and electrical load calculations
Single line diagrams and panel schedules
Bill of quantities for all services

process.title: Load assessment

process.title: System selection
process.description: The right system for the budget and the building — not the largest one available.

process.title: Design & coordination
process.description: Layouts drawn and overlaid on structure to eliminate clashes before site.

process.title: First & second fix supervision
process.description: Stage inspections during concealed work, when mistakes are still cheap to fix.

process.title: Testing & handover
process.description: Pressure tests, insulation tests, commissioning and documented handover.

title: Turnkey Construction
tagline: One contract. One team. One point of responsibility.
summary: We take the plot and hand back the keys — design, materials, labour, services and finishes, all under a single agreement with a single accountable party.
description: The traditional way to build in India is to hire an architect, then a contractor, then an electrician, then a plumber, then a carpenter — and to spend the next eighteen months translating between them. Turnkey removes that entirely. One agreement covers everything, and when something goes wrong there is exactly one person to call.

features.title: Fixed scope & rate

features.title: Material procurement
features.description: We buy at trade rates and you get the benefit, with brands locked in writing.

features.title: Skilled labour
features.description: Our own supervised crews rather than a chain of subcontracted gangs.

features.title: Stage-wise quality checks
features.description: Documented sign-off at each stage by a qualified site engineer.

features.title: Milestone-linked payments
features.description: You pay for work that is finished, verified and photographed.

features.title: 1 year free maintenance
features.description: A full year of complimentary service and support after handover.

title: Interior Design & Execution
tagline: Designed and built by the same team
summary: Modular kitchens, wardrobes, false ceilings, lighting and furniture — designed, fabricated and installed by one team, so the drawing and the built result match.
description: Interior design fails most often at the handover between designer and fabricator. We do both. Every joinery item is detailed to fabrication level in our own drawings, made in a controlled workshop, and installed by the people who drew it.

title: Project Management & Tracking
tagline: You always know exactly where your project stands
summary: Live site cameras, weekly reporting, milestone tracking and a client portal — so distance, travel or a busy job never means losing visibility.
description: Most construction anxiety is really an information problem. You cannot see the site, so you assume the worst. We fix that with real infrastructure: cameras on site, a weekly photo report, a milestone plan you can check against, and a portal that shows progress, documents and payments in one place.
